data.description: Luxury Renovated 2BR Apartment | Brand-New Furniture | Walk to Metro | Orra Marina Dubai Marina
data.long_description:
Experience elevated waterfront living in this beautifully renovated 2-bedroom apartment in Orra Marina, one of Dubai Marina’s most sought-after residential communities. Featuring brand-new furniture, contemporary interiors, and a thoughtfully designed layout, this home offers the perfect combination of comfort, style, and convenience.

The apartment boasts spacious living and dining areas, modern finishes, large windows allowing plenty of natural light, and well-proportioned bedrooms designed for comfortable everyday living.

Property Features:
• 2 Bedrooms
• Fully Furnished with Brand-New Furniture
• Modern Renovated Interior
• Bright and Spacious Layout
• Fully Equipped Kitchen
• Built-in Wardrobes
• High-Quality Finishes
• Ready to Move In

Building Amenities:
• Swimming Pool
• Children’s Pool
• Fully Equipped Gym
• Padel Court
• Yoga Studio
• Children’s Play Area
• 24/7 Security & Concierge
• Covered Parking
• Direct Access to Marina Walk

Prime Location:
• Walking Distance to DMCC Metro Station
• 5 Minutes to Dubai Marina Mall
• Easy Access to Sheikh Zayed Road
• Close to JBR Beach, Restaurants, Cafés and Supermarkets
